chunks: Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī, from ʿAmr ibn Saʿīd, from Muṣaddiq ibn Ṣadaqah, from ʿAmmār ibn Mūsā, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, concerning:
Regarding a menstruating woman who performs ghusl while saffron remains on her body which the water has not removed, he said: “There is no problem.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no problem; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is the ghusl of a menstruating woman valid if saffron remains on her body?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the ghusl of a menstruating woman. It states that if saffron remains on her body and is not removed by the water, her ghusl is still valid and there is no objection.
